verdict.rationale: The only evidence touching on data deletion is a community anecdote that deleting one's Shortwave account makes it low-risk to switch back to Gmail, implying account-level deletion works, but there is no documented retention policy, granular deletion controls, or data-lifecycle settings; community comments even flag privacy concerns about email content being synced/shared with third-party vendors with no denylist option. missing for 10: documented retention policy, explicit deletion/export controls, first-party privacy/data-handling documentation.
